name: Kikai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kikai town emblem in red: a disc crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kikai, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kikai town emblem — a disc crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes
